svg.text: Play on the main Mac and the backup Mac plays the same notes.
A small Mac app for redundant live rigs.
macOS 13 or later · Apple silicon and Intel · Free (MIT)
Notarized by Apple. Unofficial third-party tool.
The main Mac’s Live also plays from the TwinKeys MIDI port. Tempo stays in sync with Ableton Link.
Each key plays the same note in both Lives
When the network comes back, so does the link
One button stops every note on both Macs
Only your Macs connect, and traffic is encrypted
Lost note-offs are cleaned up automatically
App and guide in both languages
Made by Shogo Kajiyama / SEVENTHWELL · MIT License
TwinKeys is an unofficial third-party tool. Ableton and Live are trademarks of Ableton AG.
